import base64,hashlib,io,json,runpy,sys,tarfile,zlib
from pathlib import Path
archive=base64.b64decode('')
assert hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest()=='40611d38a2eea3bb8aca34d0f8441225258226b124b5e6faa309fb7c74f1fabe'
tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)).extractall('/tmp/deltaforge-profile/code')
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/deltaforge-profile/code')
for device in ['cpu','cuda']:
    root=Path('/tmp/deltaforge-profile')/device
    sys.argv=['profile','--device',device,'--output',str(root),'--iterations','2']
    runpy.run_module('deltaforge.profile',run_name='__main__')
    for name in ['summary.json','trace.json.gz']:
        file=root/name
        original=file.read_bytes();encoded=base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(original)).decode()
        parts=[encoded[i:i+40000] for i in range(0,len(encoded),40000)]
        for part_index,part in enumerate(parts):
print('DELTAFORGE '+json.dumps(dict(event='profile_complete',terminal=True)),flush=True)
